title: Vietnamese Rice Vermicelli Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful Vietnamese-inspired meal featuring vermicelli noodles, grilled pork, and fresh herbs.
instructions: Cook the vermicelli noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Grill the pork shoulder over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes per side.
Slice the grilled pork into thin strips.
Heat the zesty sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
Prepare the banana leaves by cutting off the stem and blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
Wrap each serving of noodles in a banana leaf, adding a few slices of pork, some chopped cilantro and mint, and a few chili slices if desired.
Drizzle the rice vinegar and sesame oil over the top of each serving.
